en: The postcard consists of two sides. The front depicts an old black-and-white panoramic photograph of a coastal city with a harbor, visible ships, and a densely built urban area called 'SUNDSVALLS HAMN' (Sundsvall's port/harbor). There is cursive text written directly on the image, mostly along the lower and right edges. The reverse side shows postal marks, a stamp, and address information written in elegant handwriting. The text is primarily in Swedish and possibly some Finnish. The address mentions 'Hämeenlinna' (a city in Finland) and 'Stenberg,' as well as the recipient's name, Elli Vaskinen.
